items.premise: S270 deferred remote CI confirmation until the route-tier Lighthouse workflow ran after the main push.
liveEvidence: gh run list shows E2E Test Suite, Accessibility Audit, and Lighthouse CI success for head be052deb241a6c37484971499aa524fd5ecaa7fb
api/ci-status.json reports browserGatesGreen:true and terminalState:known_blocked with only the Worker R2 token-scope blocker
items.recipe: Close the S270 verification carry in TASK_BOARD/CURRENT_STATE/TRUTH_AUDIT and preserve the Worker blocker as known provider-token-scope, not local code failure.

items.premise: The beacon said browser gates were green but did not expose which commit the green gate set verified, making future Action churn harder to audit from the public artifact alone.
liveEvidence: scripts/build-ci-status-beacon.mjs already consumes GitHub Actions run objects that include head_sha and event
api/ci-status.json lacked per-workflow headSha/event and a unified verifiedBrowserHeadSha field
items.recipe: Persist headSha/event for watched workflows, derive verifiedBrowserHeadSha only when all browser gates are green on the same commit, and cover the contract in self-test.

items.premise: The homepage 0.85 Lighthouse target remains attractive but current committed evidence does not support claiming it during a release-truth session.
liveEvidence: D-S270.1 records current homepage evidence around 0.76
route-tier budgets are now the release source-of-truth until a trace-backed homepage performance pass lands
items.recipe: Record the deferral honestly; do not lower or raise performance claims without fresh trace evidence.

items.premise: After the full build-check run, rotate-taskboard --check-size reported four rotatable blocks beyond the three-session window.
liveEvidence: node scripts/rotate-taskboard.mjs moved 4 blocks into context/archive/TASK_BOARD_ARCHIVE.md
items.recipe: Run the existing rotation command, preserve old blocks in the archive, and verify check-size is clean.
